Ben Beary

I'm an indie game developer who builds polished, systems-driven player experiences: level design, gameplay scripting, and the tools, art, and audio that hold a project together.

I hold a BFA in Digital Media Arts from San José State University. I like solving problems with modular, efficient code, and building the tools that make the rest of the work faster.
